lead: a fault stops the line at the start of a shift and you are under the machine before the supervisor has finished the sentence, and what you take apart down there is never the part that failed.
sun: the part that failed is three faults down from the thing that made it fail, and you can be at the bottom of it by lunch. nobody is paying for that. the ticket says restore service, and restoring service means leaving in place the exact condition that will do this again in eight weeks, which you can already name, standing there with the cover off.
moon: The Gate puts you at the door first, which is the wrong place for this. first on site means nothing has been tidied into an explanation yet — the evidence is lying where it fell, and the descent starts an hour before anyone senior arrives to say what the job actually is. by the time they do, you are four levels in and the machine is in pieces.
pull: first on site is the only time a thing is still readable, and you are first on site. they wanted it running by noon. what they have is the actual reason, and no line.
tension: hours per call is how the office measures the work, and by that measure you are the worst on the rota. what does not go into a column is that nothing you have closed has ever come back. supervisors who came up on the tools protect you for a while. the ones who came up on the schedule move you onto the faults nobody else can finish, and those are rare, and the rota was where the hours were.
cost: a plant that has failed the same way for nine years stops failing after you, permanently, because you went under the broken part to the decision that put it there. what came up with you was the working arrangement around it — a shift pattern, two jobs, somebody's reputation. the trade pays by the hour, and the hour is where you lose.

lead: the family has one account of where it came from, and you are ten years into the papers behind it, and every part of it you have reached has come away in your hand.
sun: the story has a named reason and two facts propping it, and the three of them are true and hold nothing up. under those is what actually moved that generation, and it is smaller and worse and does not come apart under any test you have put to it. nothing has told you that ten years is enough. there is a further layer and you can see it.
moon: The Bearer holds it where it happened, inside. what is in there will not go out: an excavation produces no story, only the absence of one, and nobody at that table wants the demonstrated falseness of the thing they say at funerals. so the gate is yours, the timing is yours, and nothing passable has ever come to it.
pull: the family is standing on ground you took out from under it years ago, quietly, and what you have instead of their story is a hole nobody can be handed.
tension: at gatherings the story gets told again, by an aunt, in the version with the good ending, and you say nothing, and the silence of the one who has read everything is louder than a correction would be. difficult is the reading in that room. secretive is the other one. neither can see that you cannot answer a question about your own grandmother without taking her out from under two people who are still alive.
cost: what four generations need to be otherwise comes apart in your hands, correctly: you can date the marriage, find the money, name the year the account was invented. the family goes on standing on it, because standing on a thing does not require it to be true. and you sit at that table with ten years of it in you and no version anyone could live in to offer instead.

lead: from the outside it was one account with five names on it and everybody comfortable about the year. you counted it properly once, on your own, and it has not been one account since.
sun: a shortfall arrives with three explanations everybody can live with, and all three are affordable. The Root goes past all three to the one that is not: the part of the place everyone is proudest of has never paid for itself, and has been carried since the second year by the dull line nobody defends. two evenings with the statements established that, and it has not moved since under anybody's pressure, including yours.
moon: one account, one word for the whole of it, five earnings and five appetites that read from the road as a single healthy concern. going down through it resolved the object into its members, and The Gathered Stars does not put members back together — what separates stays separate. the pot is a list now, and everybody on the list can see where they sit on it.
pull: asked why there was never enough, you came back with this: the thing everybody loves has been living off the thing nobody mentions. the shared account did not survive the answer.
tension: the numbers are never what gets argued with. it is that you looked at all — four years of statements, unasked, over two evenings, which reads to everyone as a verdict on their honesty rather than on the arithmetic. suspicious first, then mercenary, and the one that sticks comes from the member your figures show has been carried for six years: that you were only ever in it for your share.
cost: two evenings gave that place the only true statement of its position it has ever had, and it will be true in ten years. the same two evenings put the money on an individual footing for good — five ledgers where there was one, each person able to see their own standing in it, and the pleasant part of belonging there was never having to know.

lead: every attack since your twenties has been logged, and the log works: you know the actual cause, you got there years before any clinic would have, and the life it took to get there is not coming back.
sun: elimination is the only honest instrument and you have run it on yourself without mercy. every finding held: the wheat at twenty-six, the hours at thirty-one, the particular house at thirty-eight, and under all of those the thing that actually sets it off, which took eleven years to isolate and has survived every attempt you have made to disprove it. each answer arrived as a subtraction. nothing was ever added back.
moon: the gap never closes. you are behind the episode, reconstructing it afterwards from what you wrote down, establishing the cause of a thing that is already over — and The Follower gives that arrangement permanence rather than progress. what comes off the list stays off. the foods, the evenings, the two friendships that ran on them, nine years since the last removal.
pull: you were right about every trigger, one at a time, over twenty years. each time you were right, something left the house and did not come back.
tension: in a consulting room this reads as the patient who has done too much reading. the notes have a word for people who arrive with their own aetiology, and you did arrive with one, and it happens to be correct. at the table it goes worse. nobody wants an evening where the host cannot eat, and the account of why has eleven years of work behind it and takes four minutes to say.
cost: you can find the true cause of something in your own body, past the three a doctor would settle for, and be right about it at a rate no clinic matches. the finding and the removal are one act here. what you have at fifty is a body that has not had an attack in four years and a week with almost nothing left in it.
